development: Reuse saved seed42 primary split and existing model predictions for low-cost feature ablations; no rerun of identical old fits. Existing seed20261017 confirmation is reused stability evidence, not a clean independent test.
outer_validation: For selected new families, use a fixed five-fold stratified split seed20261018, grouping exact predictor duplicates if present. Current audit finds zero exact duplicates. Compare models on identical held-out rows. Fixed iterations selected only on development; OOF folds are scored without early stopping. Final ensemble weights are a small prespecified set or cross-fitted meta-model, never public-score tuned.
data_leakage: All frequency/category vocabulary and unsupervised group mappings fit on outer-train only. Target encoding training rows use inner five-fold OOF within outer-train, including inner-fold priors; outer-valid/test mappings fit only on outer-train. No target-based transform is fitted on outer-valid/test. Never train or validate on leaderboard/teacher predictions from unknown provenance.
unsupervised_group_stats: Distance group count and log count; outer-train group means of all original numeric columns except distance shrunk toward outer-train global means with strength20; conditional proportions of original string categories by distance. No test distribution fitted.
target_encoding_initial: Flight Distance only, smoothing strength100, inner five-fold stratification seed20261019. Prespecified extension to distance x Class or Type of Travel only if evidence supports added interaction.
promotion: Require material same-row improvement, stable direction on the reused second split, then new fixed-fold OOF comparison before expensive full refits or major submission. Conditional intervals are descriptive and do not include selection uncertainty. Save failures and inconclusive results.
external_data: Only public licensed original dataset after verifying license and auditing exact/near feature matches and label conflicts. External teachers fit permitted original data only; exact synthetic-validation matches are excluded or explicitly measured in ablation. No blind original-data append.
submission: Only parent cloud browser submits. At most four new submissions for this window. Record public scores; do not select blend weights from small leaderboard changes. Preserve all previous best artifacts.
